# FG-GIT-0035

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 503 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ssh-transport`](../../ops/runbooks/ssh-transport.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `ssh_connections_over_the_cap_are_refused` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: SSH の接続が多すぎます。しばらく待ってからやり直してください。
- en: Too many SSH connections. Wait a moment and try again.
- id: Terlalu banyak koneksi SSH. Tunggu sebentar lalu coba lagi.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C13 (ADR-0032 §4): the SSH git transport closed a connection because of a bound. Before the SSH handshake: `reason=connection_limit` (`git.ssh.max_connections` open connections in total), `peer_limit` (`git.ssh.max_connections_per_peer` from one address; an IPv6 peer counts as its /64), `rate_limit` (more than `git.ssh.connections_per_minute_per_peer` new connections from one address within a minute) or `auth_failures` (the address failed public-key authentication `git.ssh.auth_failures_per_minute_per_peer` times within the minute: its new connections are closed until the minute ends). The client sees the connection closed (`kex_exchange_identification: Connection closed by remote host`). After it: `reason=auth_timeout` (no successful authentication within `git.ssh.auth_timeout_ms`; logged at info).

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Refusals are logged at most once per 10 seconds as one warn line `forge.ssh.connection_refused` with `error_code=FG-GIT-0035`, `reason`, `peer` (the address key), `limit`, `open` and `suppressed` (how many refusals the line stands for). Count the open connections: `ss -tn state established '( sport = :<port> )'`.

## 対処 (fix)

A burst from CI or a script: lower its concurrency or raise the caps (`git.ssh.max_connections_per_peer`, `git.ssh.connections_per_minute_per_peer`) and restart. `auth_failures`: a client offering many keys, or a scan — check the address; the user adds the key they use (or sets `IdentitiesOnly yes`). A steady `connection_limit`: raise `git.ssh.max_connections` (each git operation also takes a git stream: `git.http.max_streams`). Runbook ssh-transport.
